title: Explained: "Go Fast" UFO Video - Not Low and Not Fast - Like a Balloon!
summary: Mick West analyzes the Navy "Go Fast" UFO footage and shows with simple trigonometry and the data overlay that the object is slow and high up, consistent with a balloon. He explains how parallax makes it look fast and argues the original TV claims were wrong.
why: HN commenters repeatedly cite it as a checkable, math-based debunking of the famous UFO clips whenever UAP stories come up.

quote.text: See for yourself. This is the most clear case of misidentification.
